contracts.id: Aerospace: Navigation Map->Aerospace: Primary Flight Display
contracts.payload: { waypointId: string; desiredTrack: number /* bearing in degrees, 0-359 */; distance: number /* NM to waypoint */ }

contracts.id: Aerospace: Navigation Map->Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel
contracts.payload: { waypointId: string; label: string; desiredTrack: number /* bearing in degrees, 0-359 */; distance: number /* NM to waypoint */ }

contracts.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Primary Flight Display
contracts.payload: { selHeading: number /* commanded heading in degrees, 0-359 */; headingHold: boolean; commandedBank: number /* degrees, negative=left */; bankHold: boolean }

contracts.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Altitude Tape Readout
contracts.payload: { selAltitude: number /* commanded altitude in feet */; altHold: boolean; selVerticalSpeed: number /* commanded VS in FPM, negative=descent */; vsHold: boolean }

contracts.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Airspeed Tape Readout
contracts.payload: { selSpeed: number /* commanded airspeed in knots */; spdHold: boolean }

contracts.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Navigation Map

contracts.payload: { accelState: 'ACCEL' | 'STEADY' | 'DECEL'; thrustAvg: number /* average throttle percent, 0-100 */ }

contracts.payload: { id: string; text: string; severity: 'warning' | 'caution'; source: 'ENG' | 'FUEL' }

channelList.id: Aerospace: Navigation Map->Aerospace: Primary Flight Display
channelList.description: When the pilot selects a course/waypoint leg on the map, it emits the desired track bearing; the PFD renders the corresponding heading bug and course-deviation bar on its compass strip.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Navigation Map->Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel
channelList.description: When the pilot selects a waypoint or leg on the map, it emits the target waypoint/desired track; the autopilot loads it as the active NAV target and can arm/engage lateral navigation toward it.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Primary Flight Display
channelList.description: When the pilot dials a target heading or engages bank/attitude hold, the panel emits the commanded heading and bank; the PFD moves its heading bug and drives the horizon toward the command.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Altitude Tape Readout
channelList.description: When the pilot sets target altitude and engages ALT/VS hold, the panel emits the commanded altitude and vertical speed; the altitude tape positions its selected-altitude bug and vertical-speed target.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Airspeed Tape Readout
channelList.description: When the pilot sets target speed and engages SPD hold, the panel emits the commanded airspeed; the airspeed tape positions its selected-speed bug and trend.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Autopilot Control Panel->Aerospace: Navigation Map
channelList.description: When NAV/LNAV is engaged and the active waypoint sequences, the panel emits the active leg; the map highlights the active leg and advances the route.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Engine & Fuel Systems Panel->Aerospace: Airspeed Tape Readout
channelList.description: As thrust/throttle changes, the panel emits the resulting acceleration state; the airspeed tape updates its speed-trend vector to reflect the thrust-driven rate of speed change.

channelList.id: Aerospace: Engine & Fuel Systems Panel->Aerospace: Warning & System Status Panel
channelList.description: When an engine parameter (N1/N2/EGT) exceeds limits or fuel drops below a threshold, the panel emits a caution/warning event with source and severity; the status panel logs and displays it as an active alert.
